# Hepzibah E - Portfolio & Professional Profile

> Personal portfolio and professional profile of Hepzibah E, SEO Specialist and Digital Marketing Executive with a background in Computer Science & Engineering from Anna University.

## Core Specializations
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Keyword Research, Search Console Optimization, SEO Audits, Content Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- **Digital Marketing & Growth**: Content Marketing, Social Media Strategy, Campaign Planning, Brand Storytelling, Conversion Optimization.
- **Analytics & Business Intelligence**: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC), IBM Cognos Analytics, Data Visualization, Performance Reporting.
- **Web Development**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Responsive Web Design, Core Web Vitals Optimization, Front-End UI Development.

## Professional Experience
- **Digital Marketing Intern** at Vdart Academy: Managed content writing, editorial planning, social media campaigns, and organic SEO initiatives.
- **IBM Cognos Analytics Intern** at Adroit Technologies Innovative Solutions Pvt Ltd (via IBM): Business intelligence reporting, data visualization, and analytics dashboards.
- **Web Development Intern** at Corizo: Front-end development, responsive web design using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
- **Web Development Intern** at Hitakey Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd: UI styling and client-side scripting in production workflows.

## Key Achievements & Awards
- **1st Runner-Up — AICCI National Startup Summit 2026 Startup Hackathon**: Port & Logistics Track (in association with StartupTN) for "Freight Match" (AI-powered freight marketplace concept).
- **Academic Excellence**: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering at Dr. G. U. Pope College of Engineering (Anna University) with a CGPA of 8.62.
